balls.text: drills this yorker length ball outside leg to deep point after backing away again
launched handsomely over mid-off! Makes room and stays deep in his crease, as Boult goes very full on off. Mustafizur swings full stretch, and sends that over the rope for six
short of a length ball on middle, and he backs away to try and slap that but the ball goes over the stumps
crunches this near yorker-length ball on middle and off to mid-off after clearing his front leg
very full on off, and hoicked back to the bowler after making room and staying deep in his crease
yorker length, and swinging in too. The ball ends on middle, from where he jabs that back
full ball on off, and nudged forward to cover. Coulter-Nile ends with his best IPL figures
full delivery outside off, and he pushes at that without foot movement and away from his body. Gets an outside edge to third man

bang! Bowled him! Bowls with a scrambled seam on a good length on middle, with the ball angling into the batter. Sakariya is standing after backing away outside leg, and tries to heave that ball to the on side. But he is beaten, as the ball hits his back thigh and strikes the stumps behind
slower ball on a good length on off, and pushed to mid-off after making room

Kishan dives to his left, but the ball just evades him! He stretches out his left glove, as Sakariya gets an outside edge to this good length ball outside off. His bottom hand was off as he played at that
back of a length and just outside off. Opens the bat face to nudge that toward mid-off
goes back to the good length outside off, and gets that to dart in. Tapped off the back foot to cover. Bumrah ends his spell with 2 for 14
backs away, but Bumrah lands that yorker bang on leg. Drilled to the on side with a horizontal bat
goes back to that short delivery outside off. Sakariya sways out and ducks, and lets that pass. A late call that this was a no-ball
good length delivery slightly wide of off, and he pushes that to the man at cover away from his body
yorker now on off at 140kph! Digs that out with a low bat
goes short of a length on off, and gets that to angle in. Sakariya ducks under that, as Kishan collects that to his right
bowls full and just outside off at 139kph. Sakariya is right forward to defend that back
good length ball on off, and he opens the bat face to tap that to point
extra bounce, and beats his outside edge off a good length outside off

rapped him in front, and given leg before! Some drama there, with the umpire thinking there is a review left, but then realises Royals have none to go. Good length ball pitching outside off, and angling in to strike Miller's back pad on middle and leg. He is deep in his crease, and misses his clip to be struck right in front.
gets an outside edge as he looks to drive at that full ball on off, as the ball runs down to third man
Miller makes a little room to this good length ball on middle and off, and dabs that to third man for a single
full delivery on off, and that is blocked to ward cover with a good stride forward

and nabbed by Kishan first ball! Bumrah bowls one on a good length on off, which is straightening after pitching. Gopal pokes at that with the full face of the bat, but the ball takes his outside edge instead. Kishan has to go low to his right to complete the take, as Royals slide further with Bumrah's second strike
much fuller on his pads, and clipped to fine leg after a little step down the track
sharp bounce from Bumrah! Pitches it on a good length just outside off, as Miller fends at that with his bottom hand off, perhaps surprised by the extra bounce
leading edge, but short of cover! Full delivery on middle, and Miller goes for the flick but mistimes that. Safe in the end though
fuller in length, and on middle and leg. Clips that to deep square leg, as Coulter-Nile from fine leg runs to his right to cut that off
good length ball on off, and keeps really low while angling. Taps that to the left of the keeper after going low to play at that

soft dismissal as Neesham takes three. Good length outside off. Tewatia looks to pull through the leg side but it's such a slow delivery. Can't delay the stroke, and top-edge comfortably taken by Kishan from near his face
full and wide outside off. Slower one again. Tries to cut but past the edge. On the bounce to Kishan
full on middle, and clipped to fine leg. Is it four? No, the boundary has to wait. Tiwary runs around at fine leg to intercept
length ball angling in and clipped off his pads to deep backward square leg
full and wide outside off. Neesham taking the pace off as much as he can. Tewatia mistimes a sloggy shot to long on for one
around the stumps. Full outside off, and driven to cover. Can't get the run though
good length just outside off. Worked off his pads to midwicket for a single
full outside off. Checks a drive past cover's right. Can't get a hand to it....another single
full, slower ball. Just outside off. Soft hands as he defends to cover point. One run taken
fullish, outside off. Tapped with soft hands to point for a quick single
good length, just outside off. Defended
back of a length, outside off from around the stumps. Flat-bats a pulled shot to wide long on. Just one
full ball angling into him. Clipped to fine leg for a single
fullish outside off. Guided once again to third man for one. Mumbai won't mind it one bit with the Royals' run rate still under five
good length ball outside off. Cuts behind square and gets Bumrah at third man into the action once again
length ball angling into his pads. Uses his wrists to flick to fine leg for one
short and wide, and the cut has gone to third man where Bumrah is around
clipped to midwicket for a single
full on middle. Presses forward and defended back to the bowler once again
full on off. Stays on the back foot and taps it back to Jayant
full on middle. Miller drives to long on for a walking single
overpitched, ends up as a full toss. Smothers a drive to cover, but Rohit moves to his left to dive and intercept. Appreciated by the crowd and his teammates
full and wide. Tewatia throws his bat at this. Slapped to deep point for one
full outside off from around the stumps. Defended to the off side
full just outside off and driven to long on. Just four off the over
full on off and clipped off the front foot to midwicket
full outside off stump. Reaches out and drives to Coulter-Nile at mid off. Top commitment, trying to effect a direct-hit while falling over. Misses
full just outside off. Defended off the front foot to Pandya at cover point. Single pinched as he misfields
short and wide, but doesn't bounce as much. Cuts the low ball to deep point
yorker length, around the stumps. On off stump. Dug away
angled in, no room offered. Tewatia pushes towards mid-off
back of a length outside off, dabs towards point

between his legs! Full ball on off stump. Phillips looks to flick it across the line, but the ball stays low-ish, goes between his legs and crashes into middle stumps! Would've been lbw if that hadn't hit the stumps too
good length, on off stump. Angling in, and nudged to the leg side
good length outside off stump. Stays on the back foot and smothers it to backward point for one
around the stumps. Full outside off, and pushed to cover point off the front foot
full on off stump, and tapped off the front foot to the leg side
full just outside off stump. Comes down the ground and toe-ends a drive straight. Neesham dives, gets a fingertip to it
overpitched wide outside off from around the stumps again. Caresses a drive to deep extra cover
chopped on! From around the stumps. Full and wide. Dube stretches out to drive but it takes the inside edge and hits leg stump. Royals in big trouble and Jimmy "Golden Arm" Neesham is doing wonders!
good length, outside off stump, and tucked to backward point
full on off and nudged away to the leg side. Soft hands
good length outside off. Pollard offering very little pace himself. Cuts square to deep point. Four off Pollard's first and that's a time out
full, wider outside off. Reaches at it with hard hands. Drives, rather uppishly, to deep point for a single
good length outside off. Late cut behind square. But can't beat short third man
full outside off again. Smothered to cover, and they take off for a run despite it being close to Rohit
good length outside off stump. Punched to cover off the back foot this time
full just outside off stump. Pushed to long off for a single
full on off stump. Shuffles to the off side and then clips it off his pads to midwicket
full on middle, and angling across. Opens the bat's face and drives square. Misfield from Jayant at point, allows Dube to pinch the single
fullish, outside off. Tap and run to cover point to get off the mark
full outside off, and he presses forward to drive to Hardik at cover
yorker attempted. Just outside off. Dug back to the bowler
Neesham strikes first ball! How about that?! Length ball outside off. Samson tries to cut but he may have played the shot too early. Sliced, and Yadav at point dives forward to get the Royals captain
good length on off. Stands tall, and firmly punches to cover. Royals 41/2 after the powerplay

nearly chopped on! And five fielders congregate near Dube. That's one way to put pressure. Good length outside off, and he wants to fend off the back foot. Inside edged onto his pad and settles near his toes
good length outside off, and guided to point off the back foot

around the wickets. Length ball outside off but angling in. Ball stays low as Lewis looks to cream another leg-side slog. Misses, ball goes under the bat, and hits the back leg. Umpire Gough says out but Lewis reviews. No bat involved, and this is crashing into middle stump - Royals lose a review and their second opening batter
nudged to the leg side off the back foot
Bumrah starts off with a length ball on leg stump trying to cramp Lewis for space. But he is quick to pick the length up, and swivels to pull to square leg for four
good length, on off stump. Stays on the back foot and punches to mid on's right
good length outside off stump, and guided to third man for a single
good length outside off. Defends off the back foot, with soft hands, and tapped to midwicket
around the stumps. Good length outside off and angling in. Fended off the back foot to Hardik at cover
full on off, and skidding into middle. Tapped to mid on and they are off for a single. Counter-Nile tries to effect a run out with a direct hit but fails
back of a length on middle, and angling across to off. Samson opens the bat's face and runs it down to third man for a single
full outside off stump but angling further away. Left alone, and umpire says thats wide

around the stumps. Good length outside off. Looks to punch through cover but outside edge takes it past Bumrah at short third man! Would've saved three if Bumrah got a hand to it. Nonetheless a successful over for Mumbai
full outside off from over the stumps. Guides it to the right of third man to get off the mark
faint edge! NCN goes back to his full pace, and gets this length ball to skid through. Jaiswal wants to cut, but its taken a bottom edge to Kishan. Jaiswal out for a 9-ball 12
good length ball outside off. Jaiswal stays on the back foot, and cuts from top of off stump. Can't beat point though
good length, wider outside off. Tries to cut but inside edged past his body to the leg side instead. Ball rolls away to square leg as they scurry across for one
around the stumps. Slower ball angling into his pads. Swivels to smack a shot over midwicket, but misses. Inside edged onto his pad
full on middle and he whips a shot leg side. Finds midwicket
full on leg, and once again tucked off his pads to midwicket. Suryakumar dives to stop the one
full outside leg stump. Nudged to midwicket, and they are off for a quick run. But Suryakumar thinks he can pull off a direct hit....however, missed
length ball on leg stump. Angling across, and blocked off the back foot to mid off. Neesham runs in to stop them from taking a single
full, on leg. Tries to fend it leg side. Hard hands, in the air, but still well short of Suryakumar at midwicket
full on middle. Presses forward and drives off the bat's sweet spot. Races past the diving mid off fielder for four!
full on leg. But Jaiswal moves to the leg side while coming down the ground. Then thumps a drive through cover, and there's a big gap there for four more. 15 off the over!
clears mid on! Full on off. These two don't want to let  Jayant settle. Not turning, and he clubs a shot just over the infield
full on off and middle. Jaiswal comes down the ground but can't time the slog well. Mistimed to midwicket as he loses his position - with the head falling away - while trying to flay it
full on middle. Ball stays low. Clips to SKY at deep midwicket off the back foot
clobbered over the non-striker! Full on off. Lewis clears the front leg and muscles it just beyond the ropes. A small six, only 73 metres, but that's the advantage of Sharjah
around the stumps. Full outside off. Tapped off the front foot to cover's left
full on leg, and the flick finds Tiwary at short fine leg
pulled very well! Boult thinks he'll trouble Jaiswal with a bouncer first ball. But maybe the batter was expecting it. Leans back and then smacks it in front of midwicket
full ball zipping into his pads. Finally off the mark with a clipped shot to deep midwicket
wayward. Full on leg, and going down the leg side. Lewis misses the flick, Kishan dives to his right
inside edged onto his pads. Full just outside off. Looks to drive, but hits his pad
good length outside off stump. Punched off the back foot. Ball rolls away to Hardik at cover point
fullish, outside off. Lewis covers off stump and shoulders his arms

and wraps it up with a six! That's his fifty too. Mumbai's second largest win in IPL with balls to spare. Kishan into the runs, and Mumbai still alive. Short of a length ball on off, and he makes room to slam that pull for six beyond the deep midwicket fence
full-toss outside off, and Kishan lunges into it to loft that to deep extra cover! Beats deep point to his left as he leans into that uppish drive
good length ball on middle and off, and he loses his bottom hand in pushing that toward mid-on
lofted over long-on for six more! Full ball on middle, and he gets his front leg out of the way to just lift that with the full face of the bat. A gentle shot for six
crashed into the deep square leg stands! Low full-toss on off, and he goes down on his back knee to whack that powerfully deep into the boundary
takes a step across off, and hangs back deep in his crease to hoick that very full ball on off to deep square leg. This is a no-ball too
punches this good length ball on middle and off to cover. It is a no-ball though
flicks it to deep square leg! Gets a full ball on middle and leg, and whips that using his bottom hand for another boundary
full ball on off, and he leans into the drive to play that to cover

And Phillips saves a few again! He sprints way to his left from deep square leg and goes low with his left hand to flick the ball back off the deep midwicket boundary. Ridiculous stop! Long-on ran to his right too, but it was all Phillips there. Pandya flicked that full ball on middle and off, but seemed to have got good height and not a lot of power. Replays show the ball just avoided the rope, and so Phillips saves a run for his side
good length ball and outside off. Presents the full face of the bat to drive that to deep point
back of a length ball on middle, and punched to the fielder at cover from deep in his crease
fuller ball on leg, and the ball trickles behind the wicket off his pads. Samson gives the chase to stop that
pushes that good length ball on middle and off to deep point while playing from leg stump
gets an outside edge as he looks to flash at that good length ball outside off. A single down to third man
good length ball outside off, and punched powerfully to the man at cover
bowls a low, dipping full-toss outside off. Pandya closes the bat face, and runs that down to mid-on with a flat bat in the end
good length delivery on leg, and Pandya blocks that back with the full face of the bat

ballooned to mid-off! Sends that good length ball on middle sailing, as Fizz bowls a cutter to go with a change of pace. Suryakumar is beaten by the lack of pace as he looks to go aerial again, but mistimes it instead for the substitute fielder to grab that easily
lofts that over point for four! Opens the bat face to this fullish ball angling across, and uses his wrists to play that uppishly for four toward third man
full delivery and pitches outside leg. He flicks without foot movement, and that is called wide down the leg side
dabs this good length ball on off to point with the open face of the bat

and finds the gap between point and short third man now! But Phillips still chases that to his right to dive and get a hand. Outstanding stop there. Kishan opens the bat face to this fullish ball on off, and runs that down nimbly
looks to slash at that good length ball on middle which is angling away a touch, but is beaten
good length ball on off, and finds the man at cover with his punch

outside edge, but the ball flies for four to third man! Suryakumar goes for the drive to this full ball outside off while playing outside off, but doesn't get it off the middle. Samson dives to his right, but the ball is past him
another one on his pads. This is a good length ball, which he clips to deep square leg
swivels to pull that to fine leg now! Kuldip goes short of a length outside off, and Kishan skips a little in the crease to pull that behind for four more
bowls on a good length on leg stumps, and Kishan clips that behind to beat short fine leg to his right. Fine leg runs to his left, but is a little late on the ball
and bisects point and cover now! Plays that drive late to the good length ball outside off, as Phillips at cover runs all the way to the boundary to slide and flick the ball back
slashed to beat cover! Good length ball outside off, and played after rocking back in his crease. The cover fielder dives to his right, but in vain
cover dives to his right, but doesn't get a hand. Suryakumar presents the full face of the bat to this full ball on off, and gets a single to the left of mid-off
clips this to fine leg! Full ball outside leg, and he simply whips that using his wrists to the left of the man at short fine leg. A gift to start with, especially to an out of form batter

chipped to cover! Royals strike early. Good length ball on middle and off, and Rohit looks to loft that, but the bat turns into his hands as he plays at that aerially. Easy take by Jaiswal at cover, and Sakariya gets a wicket after seven dots in a row
skips down as Sakariya goes on a good length on middle and off, and Rohit leans into a drive to point after making room
good length ball on middle, and clipped to deep square leg
creams this drive to long-on, as Gopal goes full on middle. Kishan is off the mark off his seventh ball, and gets to 1000 runs for Mumbai
hoicks this full ball outside off to long-on rather unconvincingly

Samson misses a stumping chance! The ball drops out of his gloves after Rohit danced down to this good length ball outside off which was turning away from him. Rohit almost realises that late, and slides back into his crease. Phew!
sweeps that over fine leg! Goes down on his back knee to this full ball on off, and slogs that far and beyond. That looked like having come off the top half of the bat though
tosses it up to bowl full outside off. Tapped toward point
fuller and straighter on off, and nudged to mid-off. Sakariya extends his right hand, but doesn't get contact with the ball, and starts with a maiden
firmly drives this full ball just outside off with the full face of the bat, but finds the man at cover
short of a length on off, and darting in well. Skips in his crease to punch that to cover
opens the bat face to run this good length ball on off to the fielder at short third man
good length ball on middle, with a hint of movement away after pitching. Blocked off the back foot to cover
yorker on middle, and Kishan closes the bat face to push that to the man at midwicket
bisects cover-point and cover! Makes a touch of room before driving this full ball on middle and off with the full face of the bat. Mumbai start commandingly already
fired over the bowler's head! Change of pace again, but this is right in the slot on off, and Rohit clears his front leg a touch before lofting that for six bang over Fizz
full ball on middle and leg, and clipped to deep square leg. The man there runs across to his left, as Rohit pockets two rapidly
cuts to beat the man at cover-point! Slower ball which is short and wide of off, and Rohit waits for it to come before slashing it to the right of the man at the edge of the circle
yorker length on off, and pushed to mid-off after coming right forward
bowls full on off, and Rohit presents the full face of the bat to drive that to mid-off
